title: The best habit app ever !
body:
The best app in the store,  it not perfect you won’t find a perfect app every got some pros & cons 
But this app is the best overall it needs access to (health app and screen time) so the related habits will be filled automatically.
 free customization, the best widget, best details about your habit (daily,weakly,yearly), and you can exceed the goal lets say that one of your goals is to learn something new for 1 hour, you can enter any amount you want and the app will save your data (someday 45m the other 1h25m) you’re not restricted, other apps will be like 0 or 1 you must reach the goal or the app won’t save your data and you can’t input anything higher than the goal and that’s annoying for me and I refunded so many apps because of that, and consider adding some more features in the future (daily time line & schedule) and adding more colors to theme menu and adding more icons, because emojis doesn’t look that good they do the job, but icon looks more aesthetic but they are limited in the current version. 
And thanks for the amazing development for the amazing price.
